g.text: The Issuance Service identifies the target user (userId) and then requests the creation of a Credential Offer.
How the user is identified depends on the Issuing Provider's service and is out of the scope of this specification.
A Credential Offer that has already been retrieved
tx_code (if the Credential Offer contains a tx_code)
The kid key name is #pin or #bio
(a key registered in authentication of the Holder DID Document)
payload = { aud: credential_issuer, iat, nonce: c_nonce }
The wallet supports only ECDH-ES, so it sets alg = ECDH-ES.
If the request has no alg, the Credential Issuer chooses an algorithm
from alg_values_supported in the Issuer Metadata,
so the Metadata lists ECDH-ES only.
The Credential Issuer issues one Credential per Proof,
and the wallet sends one Proof and receives one Credential.
